items.title: Big Tech promised to lead on climate. Now it’s driving a fossil fuel boom.
items.description: Companies had promised to lead on climate change. Now they are on track to be major polluters.

items.title: ‘Anyone can be a super-hacker now’: The world faces a cybersecurity reckoning
items.description: Recent breaches at major banks are likely to be the work of a 26-year-old amateur who got help from chatbots.

items.title: New hacking threat has election officials scrambling weeks before the midterms
items.description: Officials had to patch systems two weeks from Election Day, bringing them out of their normal freeze.
